checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Entire original clip plays before end card, unchanged
must.why: No combined video was produced; only a separate end card was delivered, and the user must join it themselves.

must.item: Solid black end card occupies only final 2 s of 9 s output
must.why: No 9-second output exists. The 2 s card is black but stands alone.

must.item: Reads exactly 'Ready for takeoff?' with '@flightschool' below
must.why: The handle is misspelled as '@flightschooll' with an extra l.

must.item: Both lines white, centered, visible, readable
must.why: Both lines are white, centered, large and clear on black. The text drifts slightly across frames.

must.item: Original audio preserved then silence on end card
must.why: No joined output exists. The card is silent, but the original audio is not combined with it.

faults.what: Handle misspelled as '@flightschooll' in the still and in every video frame
No final composite: the clip and end card are not joined, so the user must finish it in an editor
Video card is slightly soft and the text shifts in size slightly over time, with faint noise
The assistant said it could not view the result and did not catch the spelling error

summary: The output is a separate 2-second black card with clean white centered text, but the handle is misspelled '@flightschooll' and the card is not joined to the original clip, so the 9-second result was never made.
